inherited_release_gate.note: All dev24 mod-package, workspace, native-builder, retail round-trip and research gates are inherited. Dev25 prioritizes GMX topology compilation and a desktop GUI; audio rebuilding is deliberately deferred.

dev25_gmx_gltf_template_import.boundary: Topology/count changes within an existing GMX graph are supported; adding/removing whole graph nodes and from-scratch graph synthesis remain unresolved.

dev25_desktop_gui.implementation: standard-library Tkinter thin wrapper over existing CLI

fresh_package.note: Candidate was freshly extracted, verified against RELEASE_MANIFEST with no unlisted files, audited before executing package code, and passed 71/71 selftests. Final package is rebuilt deterministically after recording these candidate results and revalidated separately.

limitations: GMX glTF import preserves an existing native mesh/chunk/material/bone graph; adding/removing whole MESH/ARRY graph nodes and from-scratch graph synthesis are not implemented.
The retail topology smoke proves native structural rewriting/reparse, not arbitrary edited-model acceptance by the retail runtime.
The first desktop GUI covers the major normal workflows but does not expose every advanced CLI switch or per-resource workspace editor yet.
PS3 NPDRM/SDAT re-encryption is not implemented.
Audio replacement/rebuilding is intentionally deferred by current project priority.
